title: AUD-002: Interview Coach act() Warning Elimination - Zero Console Noise in Test Pyramid
spec: Objective: Reproduce and eliminate the React act(...) warnings in tests/interview-coach-lifecycle.test.mjs (timer ticks + CBT palette updates in DashboardInterviews.jsx). Root cause expected: async event-loop dispatches outside act(). Fix: wrap timer advancements in act() and ensure mock audio cleanup on unmount. Gates: npm run test:interview exits 0 with ZERO act() warnings in output; npm run build exit 0; no changes to backend/services/aiRuntime.js or cv templates. Evidence: test log + warning-grep = 0 matches.

plan.summary: Reproduced: 21 act() warnings in lifecycle test (20x DashboardInterviews in two ~1s-spaced burst clusters at the step-17/step-18 remounts + 1x Root at final unmount). Root causes: (1) stubPlugin stubs src/firestore/dbOperations but DashboardInterviews imports getResumes from src/services/api/platform, so the real async fetch chain runs against the mocked fetch and its setResumes continuation resolves outside act() after each remount, cascading ~10 outside-act updates per mount; (2) per-second TICK/AiGenerationProcessingModal interval ticks that fire in real-time gaps outside act(); (3) final reactRoot.unmount() invoked via bare setTimeout(0) outside act(). Fix is test-side only (zero production changes): mirror the proven clean harness pattern from live-interview-ui.test.mjs.
steps: 1. Add missing src/services/api/platform stub to stubPlugin (getResumes = async () => ({ resumes: [] })) so remount async continuations resolve inside act
2. Add advanceTimers(ms) helper routing ALL real-time waits through act() (macrotask flush) and replace bare microtask flushes after mounts/clicks
3. Move final unmount inside act() (render div + unmount) eliminating the Root warning
4. Deterministically absorb interval ticks: advanceTimers(1050) inside act at exam-phase entry so the 1000ms TICK lands inside act
5. Gates: node --test lifecycle = 0 act warnings, npm run test:interview (all 4 files) = 0 act warnings + exit 0, npm run build exit 0, git diff frozen files = 0
6. Capture evidence log and submit via bridge dev submit-evidence

evidence.summary: Eliminated all 21 act() warnings in the Interview Coach lifecycle test (test-side only, zero production changes). Root cause: the keydown() helper fired window KeyboardEvents OUTSIDE act(), and DashboardInterviews' onKeyDown handler dispatches reducer actions + state setters SYNCHRONOUSLY - React 18.3+ emits the act warning at SCHEDULE time, so post-event flushing could never suppress it. Fixes: (1) act-wrapped the keydown dispatch (mirroring the proven click() helper); (2) act-wrapped remaining bare beforeunload/typing dispatches; (3) added platform getResumes stub so the real multi-await fetch chain cannot resolve outside act; (4) added advanceTimers() helper - all 18 bare microtask flushes upgraded to macrotask act windows; (5) absorbed the per-second exam TICK deterministically via advanceTimers(1050) at exam entry; (6) final reactRoot.unmount() moved inside act(). Gates verified: npm run test:interview = 31/31 pass, exit 0, ZERO act() warnings (3 consecutive deterministic runs); npm run build exit 0 in 2.36s; git diff confirms zero changes to backend/services/aiRuntime.js and cv templates.
